ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show fee to the rider's original payment method; note on the driver's record that the NS-1 free-wait was not satisfied (240 s vs the 300 s threshold) so the fee was voided, and no account flag is applied since the arrival tap was genuine (40 m from pickup).
ruling.reasoning:
The driver cancelled this trip (F4), so NS-0 sends the case to NS-1/NS-2 — the no-show fee stands only if every NS-1 condition holds [F4][NS-0]. The record confirms the driver did arrive: he tapped "I'm Here" at 14:03:30 at 40 m from the pickup point and stayed within 200 m for 5 min 30 s thereafter, with a closest approach of 38 m [F7][F8][F1][NS-1]. The driver also made contact before cancelling, sending two in-app messages (first 14:04:00) and placing one in-app call (14:05:00) [F5][F11][F12][F14][NS-1].

The waiting condition fails, however. The scheduled pickup time was 14:05:00 and the cancellation came at 14:09:00; counting the free wait from the later of arrival (14:03:30) and the scheduled time, only 240 s of waiting had elapsed against the required 300 s [F4][F6][F7][F8][NS-1]. The trace marks the wait element ✗, and with 240 s < 300 s at least one NS-1 condition fails [F6][F8][NS-1].

Under NS-2 any NS-1 condition that fails voids the charge, so the $5.00 cancellation fee on record must be refunded in full [F4][F9][NS-2]. No account flag attaches: the arrival tap was genuine — the driver was 40 m from the pickup point at the moment of the tap and never claimed otherwise — so the NS-2 flag condition (marking arrival while not at the pickup point) is not met [F1][F8][NS-2].

The rider's account (563 days, rating 4.6, no upheld no-show disputes) and the driver's account (2389 days, 644 trips, no upheld disputes) are profile facts only and do not decide the outcome; there is no repeat no-show history that would engage NS-9 [F19][F20][NS-9]. The $5.00 fee is the item on record, so the refund is $5.00 [F9][NS-2].
